People leaving this city via causeway arrive at the Sultan Iskandar Building, a checkpoint in Johor Bahru. This city still uses caning as a method of corporal punishment. Concerns over subway door sensors led this city to ban the sale of chewing gum. For 10 points, name this city-state found at the tip of the Malay peninsula.
